newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE to delist Sea-Com on Sept 28.
newsitem.headline: TSE to delist Sea-Com on Sept 28.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Friday that Sea-Com Corp would be delisted from the bourse on September 28.
Sea-Com, which is in the shipping and hotel business, said in March that it would withdraw its shares from the TSE after failing to win support for a new restructuring plan from its main creditor.
The delisting is due to the company's financial problems, the TSE said in a statement.
The company has been hurt by the bursting of Japan's late 1980s economic bubble of inflated asset prices.
